prose: A thread digest on METR's deep-access report finds Anthropic is likely improving model capabilities on well-specified tasks at about twice the rate of March 2024 to October 2025, with high uncertainty (1.3x to 3x), mostly due to using AI for R&D. Commentators say the 'dramatic acceleration' threshold in Anthropic's policy may be crossed, and extrapolations put Claude leading internal research by mid-2027. Some key findings were redacted. The sources are social posts quoting the report, so numbers come second-hand.
highlights: METR estimate: about 2x faster capability gains (range 1.3x to 3x)
Mostly attributed to AI doing R&D
Commentators extrapolate to near-automation by end of 2027
